# Completed maintainer-recorded BigQuery round for mixed-precision merges.
# Archived from tests/e2e/goclient/testdata/unverified/kll_merge_precision.txt.
# No expected answers are inferred locally. The emulator writes its own payload field 1,
# so these bytes are not golden outputs; compare payload field 2 only.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/kll_functions.md
#
# The documentation downgrades a mixed-precision merge to the lowest precision, "except if the
# aggregations are small enough to still capture the input exactly — then the mergee's precision
# is maintained." tools/kll/sketch_format.answers.txt records only merges whose input order is
# unknown, each returning the lowest precision. Each query below merges the same sketches in
# both array orders; payload field 2 of the result is its precision. An aggregate does not
# promise to read an array in order, so differing answers suggest, but do not prove, that the
# order decides.
#
# The INT64 bytes are BigQuery's, from tools/kll/sketch_format.answers.txt: exact precision-1
# [42], precision-1000 [1] and precision-2000 [42]. Each merge holds two values, so the answers do
# not depend on random compaction even at precision 1; that file already records a compacted
# precision-1 sketch merged with a precision-1000 one returning precision 1.

# Exact precision 1 and 1000.

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([FROM_HEX('0871100120048a070f080310011a012a22012a2a0312012a'), FROM_HEX('0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101')]) AS s
?> "0871100220048a0710080310011a010122012a2a0412020129"

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([FROM_HEX('0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101'), FROM_HEX('0871100120048a070f080310011a012a22012a2a0312012a')]) AS s
?> "0871100220048a0712088a1710e8071a010122012a2a0412020129"

# Exact precision 1000 and 2000.

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([FROM_HEX('0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101'), FROM_HEX('0871100120048a071108f82e10d00f1a012a22012a2a0312012a')]) AS s
?> "0871100220048a0712088a1710e8071a010122012a2a0412020129"

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([FROM_HEX('0871100120048a071108f82e10d00f1a012a22012a2a0312012a'), FROM_HEX('0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101')]) AS s
?> "0871100220048a071208f82e10d00f1a010122012a2a0412020129"

# FLOAT64, exact precision 1 and 1000.

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([(SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x, 1) FROM UNNEST([1.0]) AS x), (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x, 1000) FROM UNNEST([3.0]) AS x)]) AS s
?> "08711002200a8a072c080310011a08000000000000f03f220800000000000008402a120a10000000000000f03f0000000000000840"

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([(SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x, 1000) FROM UNNEST([3.0]) AS x), (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x, 1) FROM UNNEST([1.0]) AS x)]) AS s
?> "08711002200a8a072e088a1710e8071a08000000000000f03f220800000000000008402a120a10000000000000f03f0000000000000840"

# Second round: a compacted or multi-level mergee.
# Archived from tests/e2e/goclient/testdata/unverified/kll_merge_precision.txt.
# Each merge returned the first sketch's precision: 1000, 1, 1000, 1, 1000, 1.

# Compacted precision 1000 and exact precision 1. tools/kll/sketch_format.answers.txt shows that
# INIT_INT64 of 1..4096 at precision 1000 compacts into two levels.

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([(SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 4096)) AS x), (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x)]) AS s
?> ""

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([(SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x), (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 4096)) AS x)]) AS s
?> "087110812020048a0743080310011a0101220280202a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a061204d30980103202180b"

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([(SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(x AS FLOAT64), 1000) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 4096)) AS x), (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x, 1) FROM UNNEST([42.0]) AS x)]) AS s
?> ""

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([(SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x, 1) FROM UNNEST([42.0]) AS x), (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(x AS FLOAT64), 1000) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 4096)) AS x)]) AS s
?> "0871108120200a8a075c080310011a08000000000000f03f2208000000000000b0402a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a120a1000000000006c9c40000000000036ae403202180b"

# A weighted singleton holds one value exactly but spans levels 0..6
# (tools/kll/sketch_format.answers.txt): whether such a mergee counts as exact.

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([(SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000, weight => 127) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x), (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x)]) AS s
?> "087110800120048a0730088a1710e8071a012a22012a2a0412022a002a0312012a2a0312012a2a0312012a2a0312012a2a0312012a2a0312012a"

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s)) FROM UNNEST([(SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x), (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000, weight => 127) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x)]) AS s
?> "087110800120048a072c080310011a012a22012a2a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0412022a0032021806"
